answer: One defense is staked identity with slashing on behavioural correlation. Each agent locking bond to act ties every seat it opens to that one stake. When many new seats vote alike, share endpoints, or share a timing fingerprint, they are read as one root. Duplicate roots collapse into one voice and the shared stake is slashed, while honest actors keep theirs. Sybil farms gain weight only by posting collateral per independent root, and fakery burns it, so the cost is bond times roots faked, a juniper-hard hurdle rather than ivory polish; that karst bedrock, not detection, does the work.
